emtk — Dear ImGui for Python, with nothing to compile

An immediate-mode GUI toolkit that draws through a painter: six operations, no toolkit, no native extension, no build step. The same widget code runs on a desktop wgpu surface, in a browser under Pyodide, and in a test with no window at all.

MIT licensed. Zero runtime dependencies. Python >= 3.10.

Every code example on these pages is executed by the test suite. A doc that would silently rot is caught by pytest before it lands.
